notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "Journey"
notes.content:
Hello players!

I'm happy to finally announce that the 7th major update for Kingdom-Heroes is named the "Journey" update and is now live!
The focus of this update is mainly on events and overhauls.

Some of the new things are:

new halloween, christmas and easter events
new loading screen tips
an overhaul to the tutorial, campaign and map editor


Also some bug fixes that come with every update.

I hope that you have fun with the update and until the next announcement! :)

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "Experience"
notes.content:
Hello players!

I can finally announce that the 6th major update for Kingdom-Heroes is named the "Experience" update and is now live!
The focus of this update is mainly on quality of life and other technical features.

Some of the new things are:

a selectable fps limit (60, 120 or 144)
a proper loading screen with helpful tips
new Steam achievements
a reworked tutorial


Also some bug fixes that come with every update.

I hope that you have fun with the update and until the next announcement! :)

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "The Guardians"
notes.content:
Hello people!

I'm proud to announce that the 5th major update for Kingdom-Heroes with the name "The Guardians" is now live!
The main addition is the brand new 3rd chapter of the campaign.

But there are more additions:

a few brand new music tracks
a new Steam Achievement


Also quality of life improvements and the usual bug fixes that come with every update.

I hope that you have fun with the update and until the next announcement! :)

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "Secrets"
notes.content:
Hello people!

I'm very happy to announce that the 4th major update for Kingdom-Heroes with the name "Secrets" is now live!
The main additions are 3 new buildings that will randomly spawn on the map:

the resource warehouse
the mercenary camp
the marketplace


It also includes many other things like an overhaul and extension for the tutorial, the transformation of the desert map to the savannah map and new gameplay mechanics.
A few other notable things are 3 new steam achievements, quality of life improvements, some performance improvements and the usual bug fixes that come with every update.

Have fun with the update and until the next announcement! :)

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "The Rise"
notes.content:
Hello players!

The third major update for Kingdom-Heroes named "The Rise" is now live!
It includes the second chapter of the campaign and some visual changes to the game.

Also this update brings a bunch of quality of life improvements as well as many bug fixes.
The plan for 2021 is to feed the game with updates and fixes more frequently so bugs etc. can be ruled out quicker.

Have fun while playing the second chapter! :)
Until the next announcement!

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "Battlegrounds"
notes.content:
Hello players!

The second major update for Kingdom-Heroes named "Battlegrounds" is now live!
It includes a brand new Map-Editor mode in which you can build your own battlegrounds.
Every map that you have created in the Map-Editor is playable through: 
New game -> Custom map

Also this update brings a bunch of quality of life improvements as well as many bug fixes.

Have fun building your own maps! :)
Until the next announcement!

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update: "New Horizon"
notes.content:
Dear players,

It's finally done! After a lot of work, the first major update called "New Horizon" is live!
This update implements a brand new campaign mode!
But there are many other smaller improvements like better graphics, better performance, bug fixes etc.
At the moment the campaign only includes the first chapter, but I will add more chapters in future updates!
I hope you have fun with this update! :)

Until the next announcement! :D

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update v0.03
notes.content:
Hello Players!

I'm very happy to announce that Early Access version 0.03 for Kingdom-Heroes is here!
The theme of this update is "atmosphere" as it implements and improves many visual and audio effects.

This update features:

- A cool little day/night system
- A brand new rain system
- Many new atmospheric sounds 
- Improvements on the fight/battle system
- A few visual and functional improvements on the UI
- Some little performance improvements
- Bug fixes
- (And a Halloween themed main menu that will stay for Halloween :D) 


I hope you like it!
Have fun and until the next announcement! :D

notes.title: Kingdom-Heroes Update v0.02
notes.content:
Hello Players!

It's finally time to announce that Early Access version 0.02 for Kingdom-Heroes is here!

This update features:

- A new graphic style with a cool outline shader
- Map changes and improvements to both maps
- A new message system for various game messages
  (too less resources, no space, unit limit etc.)
- A redesigned menu for the main building, barracks and workshop
- Some little performance improvements
- Many many bug fixes


I hope you like it!
Have fun and until the next announcement! :D

notes.title: Hotfix #1 is live!
notes.content:
Dear players!
The first Hotfix for Kingdom-Heroes is live now.

This update improves placement of buildings:
(They can now be placed closer to solid objects)

The accessibility of workers when working:
(You can now stop them while working and assign them a different task)

And the research screen:
(You can now better see what you are currently reasearching when opening the research screen)


And with that said:
Until the next announcement!
